Opening._comment: Location-free starting hub for the opening story event.

Peach's Castle._comment: The broad castle region includes early castle checks; the source list does not distinguish all early vs endgame rooms.

Cavi Cape._comment: Cavi Cape and its cave are treated as one region because the source checks do not split them.

Trash Pit._comment: First Mario and Luigi area inside Bowser.

Airway._comment: Inside-Bowser route after the hammers are obtained.

Toad Town Caves._comment: Cave route to the Pipe Yard.

Toad Town.requires: |Toad Town Caves - Pipe Yard Exit Opened| or |Bowser - Reaches Toad Town|
Toad Town._comment: Shared hub. Either the Bros open the Pipe Yard route or Bowser reaches town.

Plack Beach._comment: Accessible during Bowser’s early route; later Bros checks are represented in the same area.

Pump Works._comment: The Sea Pipe Statue encounter opens Pump Works.

Dimble Wood.requires: |Plack Beach - Broque Sends Bowser to Dimble Wood|
Dimble Wood._comment: Broque and Broggy direct Bowser to Dimble Wood; later Star Cure story revisits it.

Bumpsy Plains._comment: Overworld route toward Toad Town and Blubble Lake.

Blubble Lake.requires: |Plack Beach - Route to Blubble Lake Opened|
Blubble Lake._comment: Bowser raises the tower from the lake during the story.

Tower of Yikk._comment: Tower access precedes the Boo-Ray Machine and the route into Energy Hold.

Energy Hold._comment: The Boo-Ray Machine enables the Bros to explore this area.

Joint Tower._comment: Event-only region for the Body Slam pressure-point sequence.

Flab Zone._comment: Inside-Bowser exploration after the Pipe Yard becomes available.

Bowser Castle._comment: Body Slam opens Bowser’s castle route and its later story checks.

Tunnel._comment: Bowser-only tunnel access after Body Slam.

Peach's Castle Garden._comment: Endgame garden checks are gated behind the Miracle Cure.

Challenge Node._comment: Optional challenge checks are kept out of the opening spheres.
